items.title: Zoo Safety 🐒
items.fact: Most zoo accidents happen because visitors get too close to the animals.
narration: What's the most dangerous thing at the zoo?
It's not the animals, it's us!
We need to keep a safe distance.
items.description:
Join Halmoni at the zoo to learn about wildlife safety. What's your favorite animal to visit at the zoo? Do you know how to stay safe around them?

Today's fun fact: Most zoo accidents happen because visitors get too close to the animals.

items.title: Stormy Dance 🌪
items.fact: Thunderstorms on Earth can be thousands of times stronger than those on Mars.
items.activity: watching a thunderstorm safely from the porch
narration: What's the wildest weather in our universe?
I love watching thunderstorms from my cozy porch!
Che bello! The thunder is like a big drumbeat!
Did you know thunderstorms on Earth are much stronger than those on Mars?
Stay curious, stay safe, and we'll see you tomorrow!
